To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose an algorithm for learning a model from noisy exemplars and denoised rules, and show that the resulting model is more accurate than existing models for learning from a mixtures of exemplars and rules.

we propose a novel rule-exemplar approach to learning from labeled exemplars that is more accurate and efficient than previous methods, and that the coupled rule-exemplear supervision is effective for rule denoising.

(1) we propose an algorithm that jointly denoise rules and train a model using a soft implication loss, and (2), our algorithm is more effective than several existing methods for learning from a mix noisy and clean supervision.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of learning from rules generalizing labeled exemplars.

the following question: how can we learn a model that is more accurate than existing methods of learning with a mix of clean exemplars and noisy rules, and also more accurate than existing rule-learning methods?
the problem of learning from a combination of rules and exemplars.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the rule-exemplar approach is a promising way to combine the efficiency and interpretability of rules with the accuracy of exemplars.
the rule-exemplar algorithm is effective at learning from noisy and sparse supervision.
the rule-exemplar framework is an effective way of combining the efficiency of rules and the accuracy of labels.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel way to combine the efficiency and quality of supervision, and demonstrate its efficacy on five real-world tasks.
we propose a new method of learning from rules generalizing labeled exemplars that outperforms several existing approaches.
we have proposed an efficient method of obtaining high-quality supervision for learning from rules.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the supervision can be made both human-friendly and synergistic for machine learning.
rules and exemplars can be combined synergistically for collecting supervision.
learning can be made more efficient by combining rules and labels in a synergistic way.
